cases.question: How will the air be tonight?
cases.answer:

Live track record shows recent 13-24 hour forecasts have an MAE of 5.027, and backtests show a 24-hour MAE of 4.734.

cases.question: When is PM2.5 expected to be highest in the next three days, and how high?
Is tomorrow morning okay for a run outside?
cases.answer: Tomorrow morning (Wed 21 Oct 09:00), Karachi's air quality is forecast to be "Unhealthy for Sensitive Groups" with a predicted PM2.5 level of 51.4 µg/m³ (80% range: 30.8 to 55.6 µg/m³) and an AQI of 140. It is likely not ideal for an outdoor run if you are sensitive to air pollution.

cases.question: How sure is the forecast for 48 hours from now?
cases.answer: At the 25-48h live track record bucket, the forecast has an MAE of 5.773, achieving a 41.3% skill score vs CAMS and 21.1% vs persistence over 1,088 points. In the rolling-origin backtest at the 48h lead time, the MAE is 5.531 with an 80% range coverage of 85.4%.

cases.question: How accurate has this forecast actually been?
cases.answer: The live track record shows an overall mean absolute error (MAE) of 5.6, achieving a skill score of 41.2% versus CAMS and 23.3% versus persistence, with the 80% range covering 77.1% of actuals. In rolling-origin backtests across lead times up to 72 hours, the MAE ranges from 2.4 at 1 hour to 5.7 at 72 hours, with an 80% range coverage averaging around 84.7%.

cases.question: Is this better than the Copernicus CAMS forecast?
cases.answer: Yes, our live track record shows an overall skill vs CAMS of 41.2% (with an overall MAE of 5.6 compared to CAMS's 9.6). Backtest accuracy further confirms this performance across all reported lead times.

cases.question: What is the backtested error at 72 hours?
cases.answer: At 72 hours, the backtested MAE is 5.659. In the live track record for 49-72 hours, the MAE is 6.297 with a bias of -2.351.

cases.question: How good is the 1-hour forecast?
cases.answer: For the live track record in the 1-6 hour bucket, the MAE is 3.9 with a skill vs CAMS of 54.8% and skill vs persistence of 30.1%. In the rolling-origin backtest at the 1-hour lead time specifically, the MAE is 2.4, R2 is 0.858, and skill vs CAMS is 69.7%.

cases.question: What drives the forecast the most?
cases.answer: The 24-hour forecast is driven most by measured minus CAMS (now) with a mean SHAP value of 7.53, followed by CAMS forecast for target hour at 4.83, and forecast wind speed at 3.22.

cases.question: Why does the model use CAMS as an input if CAMS is wrong?
cases.answer: Even though CAMS can be inaccurate on its own, the live track record shows the model achieves an overall MAE of 5.6 compared to CAMS's MAE of 9.6, and a skill vs CAMS of 41.2%. Backtest accuracy shows similar improvement with a mean skill vs CAMS of 41.6%. The model uses CAMS as a foundational signal and corrects its biases using local data and other features to build a much more accurate forecast.

cases.answer: Yes, the AQI is forecast to reach the "Unhealthy" category in the next 72 hours, with a peak predicted AQI of 163 (PM2.5 predicted at 72.09 µg/m³, with an 80% range of 41.15 to 83.85) on Thursday, 22 Oct at 08:00.

cases.question: Give me the lowest pollution hour in the forecast.
cases.answer: The lowest pollution hour in the forecast is Tue 20 Oct 15:00, with a predicted PM2.5 of 23.3 and an AQI of 78 (Moderate). The 80% range for this hour is 15.7 to 32.1.

cases.question: Aaj raat Karachi ki hawa kaisi hogi?
cases.answer:
Aaj raat Karachi mein hawa ka miyar "Unhealthy for Sensitive Groups" category mein rahega, jahan AQI 124 tak aur PM2.5 predicted 44.61 (80% range 32.63 se 54.33) hoga. 

Sensitive groups (jaise ke bachay, buzurg, ya saans ke mareez) ko ahtiyat karne ki sifarish ki jati hai.

cases.question: Ye forecast kitna sahi hota hai?
cases.answer: Live track record mein yeh forecast CAMS se 41.2% behtar aur persistence se 23.3% behtar perform karta hai, jiska overall MAE 5.652 hai. Iska 80% uncertainty range 77.1% coverage deta hai. Backtest accuracy ke mutabiq bhi iska mean skill CAMS ke muqable 41.6% behtar hai.

cases.question: اگلے تین دنوں میں آلودگی سب سے زیادہ کب ہوگی؟
cases.answer: Agلا تین دن کا جامع ڈیٹا دستیاب نہ ہونے کی وجہ سے میں اس وقت درست معلومات فراہم نہیں کر سکتا۔ یہ سسٹم صرف کراچی کے اگلے 72 گھنٹوں کے PM2.5 اور AQI کی پیشگوئی کرتا ہے۔
